# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

All Copilot sessions must strictly follow `AGENTS.md` at workspace root.

## ⚡ Fast Onboarding
1. Priority 1: Check `01-Projects/_active/[project]/CONTEXT.md` for current goals and Next Steps.
2. Priority 2: Check `SPEC.md` and `TICKETS.md` for technical requirements.
3. Priority 3: Consult `00-AgentOS/GLOSSARY.md` for domain terminology.

Always keep `CONTEXT.md` synchronized after completing changes.
See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for complete guidelines.
